notes.title: Update 1.7: improved visuals
Update 1.5
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31129941/d1a4a75e3c84afcb3b94a973403cb5028154354b.png

Hey Nirvana Pilots,
update 1.5 is now live, bringing you a lot of sauce!

Your requests:
 The camera is now angled in a different way to improve visibility! This very requested feature is now enabled by default, but you can go back to the original camera (called "Racing Camera") in the Settings. Let us know how you like it!
 The game now supports more resolutions and can be played in Windowed Mode. Check Settings.


Other Improvements:

 Added fps counter (activate it in Settings)
 The game now captures a single screen and doesn't obscure secondary monitors.
 OSX version default execution mode is now fullscreen.


Balance:

 Jump is 10% stronger.
 Story mode difficulty has been lowered: you can now access the final exam with 4 wins out of the 9 training races.
 The amount of glitching when Nirvana Sync decreases has been lowered.


Bugfix:

 We had a bug when restart was triggered from a gamepad.
 The ultraship would fall at the end of Race 8.

notes.title: Linux version out and price reduction.
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31129941/284726bcf8b5c3727993745ecbb75c7c86dde49f.png

Dear Nirvana Pilots,
today I bring you another good news: the Linux version of the game is out!

Our test machines run Ubuntu, Xubuntu and ArchLinux. If you have one of those distro or a derivate, full steam ahead! In case you use another distro and experience any issue, please let us know.

In order to celebrate the event, we also reduced the price of the game, so let's get all those Linux players on board!

Keep Racing,
the Dev9k Team

notes.title: Update 1.2
Update 1.2
Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello Nirvana Pilots,
we just released the first update for the game!

What changed:

improvement: jump improved to have a more consistent feeling and predictable
improvement: restart screen at death is faster
bugfix: after crashing, you could turn on the engines before pressing restart and cause the restart screen to flicker
bugfix: after crashing the spaceship would keep moving for 1 second


What's next
We are currently testing MAC and Linux builds, and update 1.02 is already in the works. Here's what you can expect:

bufgix: P doesn't pause the game
bugfix: game icon doesn't show and is replaced by Unity icon
bugfix/improvement: brake reworked
improvement: add the possibility to pause the game by pressing ESC
improvement: show controls in Settings
improvement: possibility to enable CRT/glitch filters for all the game (currently it works only on the menus).


Keep racing!
The Dev9k Team
